mentions.name: Today I Will Destroy You
mentions.description: A game featuring a melee combat system inspired by Sekiro, Tunic, the Zelda games, and Death's Door. The melee combat system is currently in prototyping, with a playable build available on itch.io.
mentions.source_excerpt: Prototyping the melee combat system for my next game, Today I Will Destroy You. It's mostly inspired by Sekiro, Tunic, the Zelda games, and Death's Door.
mentions.author: piinecone
